notes: Rai news articles live on www.rainews.it (www.rai.it is a JS shell that links there); no date archive pages and no sitemaps on www.rai.it itself, no Sitemap line in its robots.txt. Official monthly article sitemaps are declared in rainews.it robots.txt (sitemap.xml index): sitemap.rainews.articoli.{MM}.{YYYY}.xml, 800-1100 URLs/month, <lastmod> = publication day (use it to pick the day). TGR regional sitemaps (sitemap.<region>.articoli.MM.YYYY.xml) exist separately if regional coverage is wanted.
